title: Cat City Rampage
summary: Two mischievous cats race to grab the yarn at the top of a skyscraper, smashing and clawing their way up.
description: Race your friend's cat up a crumbling building. Destroy walls to create paths and be the first to reach the yarn ball at the top!

safety.privacy: Local-only play with no accounts, chat, sharing, or saved data.
safety.adultHelp: None required. This is a silly, playful game about cartoon destruction with no consequence or pressure.
safety.notes: Two-player competitive game. Cartoon destruction of buildings. No timers, no failure states, just fun chaos. Both cats are always visible on screen.
